subject.why: The subject is clearly a camp coffee pot with all requested parts including the bail handle, side handle, lid, spout, and daisy motif.

category.why: Follows Category 3 perfectly: a smooth stylized tabletop surface with a clean gradient wall behind it and no extra props.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The pot is centrally placed with well-balanced margins on all sides and a bold, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: Vibrant, warm, and saturated, with the blue enamel contrasting sharply against the bright orange gradient background.

detail.why: Appropriate level of detail with smooth stylized surfaces and no micro-textures or visual clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style with clean 3D volumes, smooth highlights, and satin gloss enamel finish.
